description: Mediation Boards Commission - Notice calling for Nominations for the appointments of Mediators
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the appointment of judicial officers (Mediators and Chairmen for Mediation Boards) by the Mediation Boards Commission. It details the process for calling and submitting nominations, which falls under judicial administration and the appointment of officers responsible for alternative dispute resolution, aligning with the Judicial/Law Enforcement category (Type 9).
